CSS Classes

HTML
.zak-ai-prompt               /* Main container card */
.zak-ai-prompt-toolbar       /* Top toolbar row */
.zak-ai-prompt-textarea      /* The textarea itself */
.zak-ai-prompt-footer        /* Bottom bar with actions */
.zak-ai-prompt-footer-left   /* Left side of footer */
.zak-ai-prompt-footer-right  /* Right side of footer */
.zak-ai-prompt-hint          /* Keyboard shortcut hint text */
.zak-ai-prompt-count         /* Token/character count */
.zak-ai-prompt-enhance       /* "Enhance" gradient button */
.zak-ai-prompt-send          /* Send button */
.zak-ai-prompt-model         /* Model selector dropdown */

JavaScript

Auto-expand textarea and keyboard shortcut handling.

HTML
// Auto-grow textarea
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-ai-prompt-autogrow').forEach(ta => {
    ta.addEventListener('input', function() {
        this.style.height = 'auto';
        this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 300) + 'px';
    });
});

// Token count estimation (rough: 1 token â‰ˆ 4 chars)
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-ai-prompt-textarea').forEach(ta => {
    ta.addEventListener('input', function() {
        const count = this.closest('.zak-ai-prompt').querySelector('.zak-prompt-token-count');
        if (count) count.textContent = Math.ceil(this.value.length / 4);
    });
});

// Cmd+Enter to send
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-ai-prompt').forEach(prompt => {
    const ta = prompt.querySelector('textarea');
    if (!ta) return;
    ta.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            prompt.querySelector('.zak-ai-prompt-send')?.click();
        }
    });
});

// Enhance button
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-ai-prompt-enhance').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        const ta = this.closest('.zak-ai-prompt').querySelector('textarea');
        if (ta && ta.value) {
            ta.value = 'Please help me with the following:\n\n' + ta.value;
            ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
        }
    });
});
